characters.seatingPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ADDITIONAL production pixel-art office RPG sprite sheet, seated interactions and transitions.
Reference image 1 is an already approved seated animation strip of this exact character: match its identity, clothes, face, head size, pixel clusters, outline, warm shading and top-down 3/4 projection. Reference image 2 is the approved full animation sheet: use it as a reference for the standing identity and scale. Make a NEW supplementary sheet with the following additional actions, do NOT redraw the old sheet's actions.
Canvas 1024 x 2048 pixels. STRICT invisible grid 8 columns by 16 rows, 128 x 128 pixels per cell, EXACTLY 128 isolated transparent sprites. No text, labels, visible grid or background. Genuine alpha transparency. Each row is eight chronological hand-drawn frames of one action, read left-to-right. Draw only ONE specified character in all cells.
Native pixel-art, crisp stepped pixel clusters, no smoothing or painterly shading, no 3D. Same body proportions and costume throughout. Standing height approximately 86px, seated height approximately 70px with SAME head size as standing, legs bent at knees. Feet baseline y=112 in each cell. Center about x=64. Leave safe padding on every side, including hair and outstretched hands.
Important: DO NOT draw chairs, desks, computers, sofas, office background or furniture. Every seated sprite is a complete unobstructed human with feet and bent legs, visibly sitting on an invisible external chair. Seating/rest sprites will be layered with modular furniture by a game engine. Hands for work hover at desktop height and keyboard is external, not drawn. Mugs only in coffee rows.
Rows, TOP TO BOTTOM, EXACT ORDER:
1 SEATED_IDLE_DOWN: sitting upright facing viewer, legs bent toward viewer, relaxed hands on knees, gentle breath and blink.
2 SEATED_IDLE_UP: sitting upright back toward viewer, legs bent away, subtle breathing, same body and head proportions.
3 SEATED_IDLE_RIGHT: profile looking screen-right, hips stationary at invisible chair seat, knees bent 90 degrees, both feet at floor, hands on thighs, breathe and blink.
4 SEATED_IDLE_LEFT: same facing screen-left.
5 WORK_DOWN: seated facing viewer, forearms extended at desk height, complete 8-frame typing loop with alternating wrists and blink, no keyboard or table.
6 WORK_UP: seated back toward viewer, leaning slightly forward to type, subtle alternating shoulders, no keyboard or table.
7 SIT_DOWN_RIGHT transition: frame1 standing fully upright facing right, frame2 back up slightly, frame3 bend knees, frame4 lower hips, frame5 seated landing, frame6 settle, frame7 and frame8 calmly seated upright; fixed world feet and steadily lowering pelvis, SAME person scale, no chair drawn.
8 SIT_DOWN_LEFT transition: same chronological standing-to-seated transition facing left.
9 STAND_UP_RIGHT transition: frame1 same seated pose as row3, frame2 lean torso forward, frame3 push from thighs, frame4 extend knees, frame5 rise, frame6 nearly upright, frame7 and frame8 fully upright facing right; fixed world floor and consistent scale, no chair.
10 STAND_UP_LEFT transition: same chronological seated-to-standing transition facing left.
11 SEATED_COFFEE_RIGHT: remain seated profile facing right; hold white mug, raise it to lips, sip with closed eyes, lower to lap; NEVER stand up, stationary hips, no table.
12 SEATED_COFFEE_LEFT: same facing left.
13 SEATED_TALK_RIGHT: seated facing right, animated mouth and friendly alternating hand gestures, occasional small nod; hips and legs stay seated.
14 SEATED_TALK_LEFT: same facing left.
15 LOUNGE_RIGHT: seated on invisible sofa facing right; lean back comfortably, gently relax arms on thighs, shoulders drop, tiny breath and head tilt. Bent legs and feet stay attached to floor, no actual sofa or armrest.
16 LOUNGE_LEFT: same relaxed seated loop facing left.
Style should fit the existing cozy office game. Readable distinct actions, clean loop continuity, no changing costume, no hairstyle drift. Full body in every frame, no crop. Exact 8x16 topology. All rows must have visible transparent gutters; leave at least 12px between neighboring silhouettes.
Exact character identity: male manager with chestnut brown hair, navy suit, white shirt, blue necktie and black shoes. Preserve the existing character, hairstyle and color role in every single frame.
characters.transitionPrompt:
